task:
Implement email backend for the Contact section form. The form already exists in components/sections/ContactSection.tsx and uses React Hook Form + Zod validation + a server action at app/actions/contact.ts.
Goal: When someone submits the contact form, an email with their inquiry is sent TO m.sarnacki@icloud.com using a Gmail SMTP relay (Nodemailer). The email must use a polished, branded HTML template matching the site's dark aesthetic.

context.project: Next.js 14 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v3.4. Single-page portfolio site for a Polish fullstack developer (mikeroe.pl). Dark theme with design tokens defined in globals.css + tailwind.config.ts.
context.existing-form: File: components/sections/ContactSection.tsx Fields collected: - name (string, min 2 chars) - email (string, valid email — this is the SENDER / client's email) - message (string, min 10 chars — project description) - website (string, optional — HONEYPOT field, hidden from users) Validation: Zod schema (client-side) + should be mirrored server-side. Submission: calls `submitContact` server action from `@/app/actions/contact`. Status states: idle → loading → success | error.
context.existing-server-action: File: app/actions/contact.ts This file already exists but may be a stub or incomplete. Rewrite it fully per the spec below.
context.email-config:
Transport: Gmail SMTP via Nodemailer. The site owner has a Google account with an App Password configured. SMTP host: smtp.gmail.com, port: 465, secure: true.
Environment variables (to be added to .env.local): GMAIL_USER=your-gmail@gmail.com (Gmail address used as SMTP sender) GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD=xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx (16-char Google App Password) CONTACT_EMAIL_TO=m.sarnacki@icloud.com (where all inquiries land)

dependencies.note: Nodemailer runs server-side only (inside Server Actions / Route Handlers). Never import nodemailer in a "use client" component.

rules.rule: All email logic lives in server-side files only. The server action file (app/actions/contact.ts) must start with "use server". Do NOT add "use client" to any file that imports nodemailer.

Mirror the exact same Zod schema from ContactSection.tsx on the server side. Validate all fields server-side BEFORE attempting to send email. If honeypot field "website" has any value → silently return success (bot trap).

Wrap nodemailer sendMail in try/catch. On SMTP failure: return { success: false, errors: { form: "Nie udało się wysłać wiadomości. Spróbuj ponownie." } }. On validation failure: return field-level errors matching the existing error display logic in ContactSection. Never expose SMTP credentials or raw error messages to the client.

The submitContact action must return: { success: true } — on successful send { success: false, errors: { [field]: string } | { form: string } } — on failure This matches the existing ContactSection.tsx consumption pattern.
Add GMAIL_USER, GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD, CONTACT_EMAIL_TO to .env.local. Add .env.local to .gitignore if not already there. Create a .env.example file with placeholder values for documentation.
Do NOT modify ContactSection.tsx unless absolutely necessary. The frontend form, validation, animations, and UI are already complete. Only the server action and email utility need implementation.

implementation.file:
Create a reusable email module:
1. Create nodemailer transporter with Gmail SMTP config: - host: smtp.gmail.com - port: 465 - secure: true - auth: { user: process.env.GMAIL_USER, pass: process.env.GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD }
2. Export async function sendContactEmail(data: { name, email, message }): - Builds the HTML email from the template (see email-template section below) - Sends via transporter.sendMail({ from: `"Mikeroe.pl Contact" <${process.env.GMAIL_USER}>`, to: process.env.CONTACT_EMAIL_TO, replyTo: data.email, subject: `Nowe zapytanie od ${data.name} — mikeroe.pl`, html: renderedTemplate, text: plainTextFallback, }) - Returns { success: true } or throws
Important: replyTo is set to the CLIENT's email so you can reply directly from your iCloud inbox and it goes to the person who submitted the form.

# Gmail SMTP (use Google App Password, NOT your regular password) # Generate at: https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords GMAIL_USER=your-gmail@gmail.com GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD=xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx
# Where contact form emails are delivered CONTACT_EMAIL_TO=m.sarnacki@icloud.com

email-template.design-brief: The email template must feel like it belongs to the mikeroe.pl site. Dark, editorial, premium — not a generic white corporate email. It should look great in Apple Mail, Gmail, and Outlook.
email-template.structure: Use table-based layout for email client compatibility. Inline all CSS (no external stylesheets, no
email-template.email-client-notes: - All CSS must be inline (style="" attributes) - Use table/tr/td for layout, not divs (Outlook compatibility) - No CSS grid, flexbox, or calc() in emails - border-radius won't render in Outlook — that's fine, degrades to square - Use ​ (zero-width space) to prevent email clients collapsing empty cells - Test dark mode: add meta color-scheme: dark + supported-color-schemes - Image-less design (no external image URLs that might get blocked)

verification:
After implementation, verify:
1. Run `npm run build` — no TypeScript errors 2. Run `npm run dev` and submit the form with test data 3. Check that email arrives at the configured CONTACT_EMAIL_TO address 4. Verify replyTo header — clicking Reply in email client should address the form submitter 5. Test honeypot: submit with "website" field filled → should return success but NOT send email 6. Test validation: submit empty form → should show field-level errors 7. Check email renders correctly (open in browser or send to Gmail/Apple Mail)
env-setup-instructions:
Before running, the site owner must:
1. Go to https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords (requires 2FA enabled on the Google account) 2. Generate a new App Password (select "Mail" + "Other" → name it "mikeroe.pl") 3. Copy the 16-character password 4. Create .env.local in project root:
GMAIL_USER=your-actual-gmail@gmail.com GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD=abcd-efgh-ijkl-mnop CONTACT_EMAIL_TO=m.sarnacki@icloud.com
5. Restart the dev server after adding env vars
